channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from summarizedStoriesMainNLscienceAndDiscovery, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: James Webb finds cosmic structure challenging universe models
item.description: NASA's James Webb Space Telescope has revealed an ancient galaxy cluster with an unexpectedly dense concentration of dark matter, challenging existing theories.

item.title: DNA recording system traces how a single cell becomes a body
item.description: Scientists traced a mouse embryo's development from its first two cells to organ formation using a DNA recording system.

item.title: Researchers map brain's hidden structure with 539 regions
item.description: Scientists created the first detailed 3D map of the brain's lipids, revealing a hidden layer of organization.

item.title: Physicists recreate quantum effect that halts a particle
item.description: Oxford physicists reproduced a quantum effect where a particle reacts to a magnetic field without passing through it.
